visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Arithmetic Instead of an Alphabet Lookup
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each letter is searched in an alphabet string with indexOf, and the result is built with +. Use character arithmetic and a StringBuilder. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A letter's position is just c - 'a', so no lookup string or indexOf search is needed. StringBuilder avoids copying the result on every character.
